# Bidirectional_Temporal_Enhancement

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A structured mechanism in spiking transformers that processes temporal information in both forward and backward directions to enhance spike-timing-based feature representation. Enables more accurate temporal dynamics modeling in neuromorphic systems, critical for real-time event-driven processing.
